syllabus_topics: Numerical representation and introduction to MATLAB (or Python)
Data interpolation and extrapolation. Least Squares Method - Discrete L2 Projection
One-dimensional equations - Secant and Newton methods

Integration and Ordinary Differential Equations 
			– Euler, Runge-Kutta and adaptive methods

Systems of Linear and Non-Linear Equations 
			– Fixed Point, Newton methods
Numerical differentiation and integration - general and elementary case (several variables)
Partial Differential Equations – Finite Differences, Splines and Finite Elements
assessment_rules: For normal evaluation, the grade is based on MAP45 (20%), two computational assignments (20% + 20% = 40%), and an exam (40%). For re-sit and special evaluations, the grade is based on an exam (60%) and two computational assignments (20% + 20% = 40%). A minimum grade of 8 is required on the exam. Grades for assignments and final grades equal to or greater than 18 may require an oral defense.
